title: The Bremen Town Musicians
moral: Old or small, together we can do anything.
notes: 영어 읽어 주기 대본(docs/READ_MODE.md §3-4). text 는 한국어 줄(키), en 이 읽는 문장. reuse 는 voice_script_en.json 의 en 그대로, trim 은 같은 문장 경계에서 자른 것, new 만 새로 녹음한다. 배역·연기 지시는 read_script_el.json 의 같은 줄을 따른다.

acts.robbers:show | robbers:flee | robber:ent: 도둑 등장·도망·한밤 도둑 한 명·당하는 자리·불 끄기
acts.cut:<monster|ghost>: 만화 컷 — 컷 속 외침(VOICE_LINES cut_*)을 그대로 재사용

lines.text: 옛날 옛날, 방앗간에 늙은 당나귀가 살았어요.
lines.en: Once upon a time, an old donkey lived at a mill.
segs: Once upon a time, an old donkey lived at a mill.

lines.text: 당나귀는 오랫동안 무거운 곡식 자루를 날랐어요. 이제는 힘이 없어요.
lines.en: The donkey had carried heavy sacks of grain for a very long time. Now the donkey was too tired.
segs: The donkey had carried heavy sacks of grain for a very long time. Now the donkey was too tired.

lines.text: 다리는 후들후들, 귀는 축 늘어졌지요.
lines.en: Its legs wobbled, and its long ears drooped down low.
segs: Its legs wobbled, and its long ears drooped down low.

lines.text: 주인: "이제 일을 못 하겠구나. 너를 내보내야겠다."
lines.en: Miller: "You can't work anymore. I have to send you away."
segs: You can't work anymore. I have to send you away.

lines.text: 당나귀는 잠깐 슬펐지만, 곧 귀를 쫑긋 세웠어요.
lines.en: The donkey felt sad for a moment, but soon its ears perked right up.
segs: The donkey felt sad for a moment, but soon its ears perked right up.

lines.text: 당나귀: "괜찮아! 브레멘에 가서 음악가가 될 거야!"
lines.en: Donkey: "That's okay! I'll go to Bremen and become a musician!"
segs: That's okay! I'll go to Bremen and become a musician!

lines.text: 당나귀가 길을 가는데, 덤불이 흔들흔들.
lines.en: The donkey walked along the road, and a bush began to wiggle and wobble.
segs: The donkey walked along the road, and a bush began to wiggle and wobble.

lines.text: 덤불 뒤에서 멍멍!
lines.en: Woof, woof, from behind the bush!
segs: Woof, woof, from behind the bush!

lines.text: 덤불 뒤에서 늙은 강아지가 엉금엉금 나왔어요.
lines.en: Out from behind the bush crawled an old dog, slow and creaky.
segs: Out from behind the bush crawled an old dog, slow and creaky.

lines.text: 강아지가 헉헉, 혀를 쭉 내밀었어요.
lines.en: The dog went huff, huff, with a long tongue sticking out.
segs: The dog went huff, huff, with a long tongue sticking out.

lines.text: 강아지: "늙어서 사냥을 못 한다고 내보내졌어요."
lines.en: Dog: "I got too old to hunt, so I was sent away."
segs: I got too old to hunt, so I was sent away.

lines.text: 당나귀: "그럼 우리 같이 브레멘에 가서 음악가가 되자!"
lines.en: Donkey: "Then come with us! Let's go to Bremen and be musicians together!"
segs: Then come with us! Let's go to Bremen and be musicians together!

lines.text: 두 친구가 마을 길을 터벅터벅 걷는데, 담장 위에서 소리가 났어요.
lines.en: As the two friends plodded along the village road, a sound came from up on the wall.
segs: As the two friends plodded along the village road, a sound came from up on the wall.

lines.text: 담장 위에서 야옹~
lines.en: A meow from up on the wall!
segs: A meow from up on the wall!

lines.text: 수염이 축 처진 고양이예요. "쥐를 못 잡는다고 내보내졌어."
lines.en: This cat's whiskers are drooping. "I can't catch mice anymore, so I was sent away."
segs: I can't catch mice anymore, so I was sent away.

lines.text: 강아지: "우리랑 같이 가자! 브레멘에서 노래하자!"
lines.en: Dog: "Come with us! Let's sing in Bremen!"
segs: Come with us! Let's sing in Bremen!

lines.text: 고양이: "야옹, 나도 노래라면 자신 있어!"
lines.en: Cat: "Meow, I can sing too!"

lines.text: 고양이는 담장에서 사뿐사뿐 뛰어내려 친구들 곁에 섰어요.
lines.en: The cat hopped lightly, pit-pat, down from the wall and stood beside its new friends.
segs: The cat hopped lightly, pit-pat, down from the wall and stood beside its new friends.

lines.text: 세 친구가 마을 집 앞을 지나가고 있었어요.
lines.en: The three friends were passing a house in the village.
segs: The three friends were passing a house in the village.

lines.text: 지붕 위에서 꼬끼오!
lines.en: A cock-a-doodle-doo from up on the roof!
segs: A cock-a-doodle-doo from up on the roof!

lines.text: 지붕 위의 닭은 고개를 푹 숙이고 있었어요.
lines.en: Up on the roof sat a rooster, its head hanging low.
segs: Up on the roof sat a rooster, its head hanging low.

lines.text: 닭: "이제 나는 필요 없대. 꼬끼오…"
lines.en: Rooster: "They say I'm not needed anymore. Cock-a-doodle-doo..."
segs: They say I'm not needed anymore. Cock-a-doodle-doo...

lines.text: 당나귀: "우리랑 음악대 하자! 네 목소리 최고야!"
lines.en: Donkey: "Join our band! Your voice is the best!"
segs: Join our band! Your voice is the best!

lines.text: 닭은 푸드덕 날아 내려와 친구들 앞에 폴짝 섰어요.
lines.en: The rooster flapped down, flutter, flutter, and hopped right in front of the friends.
segs: The rooster flapped down, flutter, flutter, and hopped right in front of the friends.

lines.text: 당나귀, 강아지, 고양이, 닭. 친구 넷이 모였어요!
lines.en: Donkey, dog, cat, and rooster. Four friends together at last!
segs: Donkey, dog, cat, and rooster. Four friends together at last!

lines.text: 친구 넷은 길가 풀밭에서 신나게 노래 연습을 했어요.
lines.en: The four friends practiced their songs on the grassy roadside, full of cheer.
segs: The four friends practiced their songs on the grassy roadside, full of cheer.

lines.text: 히힝! 멍멍! 야옹! 꼬끼오! 한 명씩 차례로, 그다음엔 다 같이!
lines.en: Hee-haw! Woof! Meow! Cock-a-doodle-doo! One at a time, and then all together!
segs: Hee-haw! Woof! Meow! Cock-a-doodle-doo! One at a time, and then all together!

lines.text: 야옹, 꼬끼오, 히힝! 최고의 음악대예요!
lines.en: Meow, cock-a-doodle-doo, hee-haw! The best band ever!
segs: Meow, cock-a-doodle-doo, hee-haw! The best band ever!

lines.text: 노래 연습을 마친 친구 넷은 숲길로 들어섰어요.
lines.en: After singing practice, the four friends set off along a forest path.
segs: After singing practice, the four friends set off along a forest path.

lines.text: 해가 지고 캄캄한 숲이 되었어요. 부엉이가 부엉부엉.
lines.en: The sun went down, and the forest grew dark. The owl went hoo, hoo.
segs: The sun went down, and the forest grew dark. The owl went hoo, hoo.

lines.text: 숲을 지나가요.
lines.en: Let's walk through the forest.

lines.text: 브레멘은 아직 멀었어요. 친구들은 다리가 아프고 배가 꼬르륵 고팠지요.
lines.en: Bremen was still far away. The friends' legs were tired, and their tummies went grumble, grumble.
segs: Bremen was still far away. The friends' legs were tired, and their tummies went grumble, grumble.

lines.text: 닭이 나무 꼭대기로 푸드덕 올라갔어요.
lines.en: The rooster flapped up to the top of a tree.
segs: The rooster flapped up to the top of a tree.

lines.text: 닭: "저기 불빛이 보여요! 집이 있어요!"
lines.en: Rooster: "I see a light over there! There's a house!"
segs: I see a light over there! There's a house!

lines.text: 친구들은 불빛을 따라 살금살금 걸어갔어요.
lines.en: The friends tiptoed quietly, step by step, toward the light.
segs: The friends tiptoed quietly, step by step, toward the light.

lines.text: 친구 넷은 숲속 집 앞에 도착했어요.
lines.en: The four friends reached the house in the woods.
segs: The four friends reached the house in the woods.

lines.text: 불빛이 새어 나오는 창문이에요. 그런데 너무 높아서 아무도 안 닿아요.
lines.en: Light is shining out of a window. But it's so high that no one can reach it.
segs: Light is shining out of a window. But it's so high that no one can reach it.

lines.text: 서로 등에 올라서 탑을 쌓아요!
lines.from: 서로 등에 올라서 탑을 쌓아요! 크고 무거운 친구가 맨 아래예요.
lines.en: Let's climb onto each other's backs and build a tower!
segs: Let's climb onto each other's backs and build a tower!

lines.text: 당나귀가 맨 아래! 튼튼해요.
lines.en: The donkey goes at the bottom! So strong.
segs: The donkey goes at the bottom! So strong.

lines.text: 그 위에 강아지가 폴짝, 또 그 위에 고양이가 사뿐 올라갔어요.
lines.en: Hop! The dog climbed on top, and then, pit-pat, the cat climbed up on the dog.
segs: Hop! The dog climbed on top, and then, pit-pat, the cat climbed up on the dog.

lines.text: 흔들흔들! 더 크고 무거운 친구가 먼저예요.
lines.en: Wobble, wobble! The bigger, heavier friend goes first.
segs: Wobble, wobble! The bigger, heavier friend goes first.

lines.text: 당나귀, 강아지, 고양이, 닭! 닭이 창문에 닿았어요!
lines.en: Donkey, dog, cat, rooster! The rooster reached the window!
segs: Donkey, dog, cat, rooster! The rooster reached the window!

lines.text: 맨 위에 올라간 닭이 집 안을 살펴보았어요.
lines.en: Rooster, up on top, peeped into the house.
segs: Rooster, up on top, peeped into the house.

lines.text: 창문 안을 들여다보니, 도둑 셋이 금화를 세며 맛있는 걸 먹고 있어요.
lines.en: Peeking through the window, three robbers are counting gold coins and eating tasty food.
segs: Peeking through the window, three robbers are counting gold coins and eating tasty food.

lines.text: 도둑: "금화가 잔뜩이다! 하하하!"
lines.en: Robber: "Look at all this gold! Ha ha ha!"
segs: Look at all this gold! Ha ha ha!

lines.text: 도둑: "이 빵도 고기도 냠냠, 다 내 거야!"
lines.en: Robber: "Yum, yum, all this bread and meat is mine, mine, mine!"
segs: Yum, yum, all this bread and meat is mine, mine, mine!

lines.text: 닭이 친구들에게 소곤소곤 속삭였어요.
lines.en: The rooster whispered, psst, psst, to its friends.
segs: The rooster whispered, psst, psst, to its friends.

lines.text: 닭: "우리 음악을 크게 들려주자!"
lines.en: Rooster: "Let's play our music nice and loud!"
segs: Let's play our music nice and loud!

lines.text: 창문 밖의 친구 넷이 함께 노래할 준비를 했어요.
lines.en: Outside the window, the four friends got ready to sing together.
segs: Outside the window, the four friends got ready to sing together.

lines.text: 다 같이 목청껏!
lines.en: All together, as loud as you can!
segs: All together, as loud as you can!

lines.text: 히힝! 멍멍! 야옹! 꼬끼오! 그리고 와장창, 창문으로 뛰어들었어요!
lines.en: Hee-haw! Woof! Meow! Cock-a-doodle-doo! And then, crash, they tumbled in through the window!
segs: Hee-haw! Woof! Meow! Cock-a-doodle-doo! And then, crash, they tumbled in through the window!

lines.text: 도둑들은 "괴물이다!" 하고 숲으로 후다닥 달아났어요.
lines.en: The robbers yelled, "A monster!" and scampered off into the forest.
segs: and scampered off into the forest.

lines.text: 친구 넷은 남은 음식을 냠냠 먹고, 불을 끄고 잠이 들었어요.
lines.en: The four friends munched the leftover food, put out the light, and fell fast asleep.
segs: The four friends munched the leftover food, put out the light, and fell fast asleep.

lines.text: 어두운 집 안에서 친구 넷은 저마다 자리를 잡았어요.
lines.en: Inside the dark house, each friend found a place to rest.
segs: Inside the dark house, each friend found a place to rest.

lines.text: 고양이는 아궁이에, 강아지는 문 앞에 누웠어요.
lines.en: Cat lay by the fireplace, and Dog lay by the door.
segs: Cat lay by the fireplace, and Dog lay by the door.

lines.text: 당나귀는 짚더미에, 닭은 천장 아래 나무 위에 있었어요.
lines.en: Donkey rested in the straw, and Rooster perched on a beam overhead.
segs: Donkey rested in the straw, and Rooster perched on a beam overhead.

lines.text: 한밤중, 도둑 하나가 살금살금 돌아왔어요. 쉿!
lines.en: In the middle of the night, one robber tiptoed back. Shh!
segs: In the middle of the night, one robber tiptoed back. Shh!

lines.text: 아궁이에서 뭔가 반짝반짝! 도둑은 불씨인 줄 알고 손을 살며시 내밀었지요.
lines.en: Something twinkled in the fireplace! The robber thought it was an ember and slowly reached out his hand.
segs: Something twinkled in the fireplace! The robber thought it was an ember and slowly reached out his hand.

lines.text: 반짝이던 것은 고양이의 두 눈이었어요.
lines.en: Those two little lights were Cat’s eyes.
segs: Those two little lights were Cat’s eyes.

lines.text: 잠에서 깬 고양이가 도둑의 손을 할퀴었어요.
lines.en: Cat woke up and scratched the robber’s hand.
segs: Cat woke up and scratched the robber’s hand.

lines.text: 도둑: "앗, 따가워! 불씨인 줄 알았는데!"
lines.en: Robber: "Ouch, that stings! I thought it was a glowing ember!"
segs: Ouch, that stings! I thought it was a glowing ember!

lines.text: 문 앞에서는 강아지가 다리를 덥석 물었어요.
lines.en: By the door, the dog nipped at his leg.
segs: By the door, the dog nipped at his leg.

lines.text: 도둑: "아얏! 다리를 콕 찔렸어!"
lines.en: Robber: "Ow! Something poked my leg!"

lines.text: 짚더미에서는 당나귀가 뒷발로 뻥 찼어요.
lines.en: In the pile of straw, the donkey gave him a big kick with its back legs.
segs: In the pile of straw, the donkey gave him a big kick with its back legs.

lines.text: 도둑: "으악! 누가 쿵 찼어!"
lines.en: Robber: "Yikes! Something kicked me, boom!"

lines.text: 그리고 들보 위에서 닭이 꼬끼오! 하고 크게 울었어요.
lines.en: And up on the beam, the rooster crowed, cock-a-doodle-doo!
segs: And up on the beam, the rooster crowed, cock-a-doodle-doo!

lines.text: 도둑: "살려 줘~!"
lines.en: Robber: "Help me~!"

lines.text: 도둑은 숲으로 달아나 다른 도둑들에게 말했어요.
lines.en: The robber ran into the woods and told the other robbers.
segs: The robber ran into the woods and told the other robbers.

lines.text: 도둑: "그 집엔 귀신이 할퀴고, 누가 다리를 콕 찌르고, 거인이 쿵 차고, 지붕에선 재판관이 도둑 잡아라! 소리쳤어!"
lines.en: Robber: "In that house, a ghost scratched me, someone poked my leg, a giant kicked me, and up on the roof a judge shouted, 'Catch the thief!'"
segs: In that house, a ghost scratched me, someone poked my leg, a giant kicked me, and up on the roof a judge shouted, 'Catch the thief!'

lines.text: 사실은 고양이, 강아지, 당나귀, 닭이었는데 말이에요! 도둑들은 다시는 오지 않았어요.
lines.en: It was really a cat, a dog, a donkey, and a rooster! The robbers never came back.
segs: It was really a cat, a dog, a donkey, and a rooster! The robbers never came back.

lines.text: 아침이 밝았어요. 친구 넷은 이 집이 참 좋았어요.
lines.en: Morning came. The four friends loved this house.
segs: Morning came. The four friends loved this house.

lines.text: 집 안에 모인 친구 넷은 여기서 살기로 했어요.
lines.en: Together in the house, the four friends decided to stay.
segs: Together in the house, the four friends decided to stay.

lines.text: 친구 넷은 신이 나서 폴짝폴짝 뛰었어요.
lines.en: The four friends were so happy they hopped and hopped for joy.
segs: The four friends were so happy they hopped and hopped for joy.

lines.text: "브레멘은 못 갔지만, 여기가 우리 집이야!"
lines.en: "We never got to Bremen, but this is our home!"
segs: We never got to Bremen, but this is our home!

lines.text: 당나귀: "다 같이 있으니까 하나도 안 무서워!"
lines.en: Donkey: "With all of us together, nothing is scary at all!"
segs: With all of us together, nothing is scary at all!

lines.text: 닭: "자, 이제 기쁨의 노래를 부르자! 꼬끼오!"
lines.en: Rooster: "Now let's sing our song of joy! Cock-a-doodle-doo!"
segs: Now let's sing our song of joy! Cock-a-doodle-doo!

lines.text: 함께라서 행복한 브레멘 음악대였답니다.
lines.en: Together, the Bremen Town Musicians were so happy.
segs: Together, the Bremen Town Musicians were so happy.

lines.text: 나이 들어도, 작아도, 함께라면 무엇이든 해낼 수 있답니다.
lines.en: Old or small, when friends stick together, they can do anything at all.
segs: Old or small, when friends stick together, they can do anything at all.
